locations.name: dorm 4F
locations.brief_description: You are in your room on the 4th floor of dorm building. There is a trash can to the north, Bahen Center to the south, and Starbucks to the west. Go find your 3 items and bring them back.
locations.long_description: You are in your dorm room where there is so much rubbish. Looking around, you see waste paper, food scraps, waste bottles, and even vegetable peelings. They don't belong here! There is a trash can to the north. Might wanna clean it up...

locations.name: Bahen 1F
locations.brief_description: You are on the first floor of the Bahen Center. Your dorm is to the north. There is a lost and found office on the second floor of Bahen, which can be accessed by an elevator in the west corner. Robarts library is to the south.
locations.long_description: You are on the first floor of the Bahen Center. You see something shiny on the ground, looks like a toonie? Maybe someone lost it? One student is rushing down the corridor, wearing a heavy-looking backpack and carrying a textbook in their arms. Looks like he is heading to Robarts library. You might get rewarded for helping him deliver the textbook.

locations.name: locker
locations.brief_description: This is your locker. There is a lot of important stuff in the locker. The trash can is to the east.
locations.long_description: This is your locker. Maybe there are items you wish to find. Thanks to your sleep deficiency, you forgot to lock your locker so now you can open it! Wait... Is this my USB Drive in the locker?

locations.name: Robarts Library 1F
locations.brief_description: You are on the first floor of the Robarts Library. There is a reading room to the west. Bahen Center is to the north.
locations.long_description: You are on the first floor of the Robarts Library. Many students are studying here. You'd better not disturb them. During your campus life, the reading room to the west is your favourite place to study, and it's also one of the most popular places on campus. Should you pay a visit?

locations.name: lost and found office
locations.brief_description: You are in the lost and found office. The only exit is to the east.
locations.long_description: You are in the lost and found office of Bahen. You noticed that on a couch, a cute little girl is crying and shouting 'Where is my toonie! It is a priceless toonie produced in 1996 and it's my 16th birthday gift from my mom!' Seems like she needs some comfort.

locations.name: Starbucks
locations.brief_description: You are in the Starbucks. Your dorm is to the east.
locations.long_description: You are in the Starbucks. The clerk is looking for the owner of a beautiful mug. There is a logo of 'University of Toronto' on this mug. OMG! Isn't this what I've been looking for?

locations.name: reading room
locations.brief_description: This is the reading room, only accessable when your score is at least 20. The exit to Robarts Library is to the east.
locations.long_description: You are in the reading room. The seats are limited, so people can only access the reading room when score is at least 20. This is always your go-to place for studying. Possibly, you left something in this room.

locations.name: trash can
locations.brief_description: You are besides the trash can. Your dorm is to the south and your locker is to the west.
locations.long_description: You are besides the trash can. The manager of your dorm recommends residents do not litter. Thus, if you put your garbage in the right place, you may earn some scores as rewards from the manager.
